title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming
entities.description: This information element indicates the forbidden tracking area identities to be stored in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming. It is included only when the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

entities.name: Satellite NG-RAN access condition
entities.description: Condition that the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access. This condition determines whether the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included.

entities.name: 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming list
entities.description: A list maintained by the UE that stores forbidden tracking area identities for roaming scenarios.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is guarded by the condition that the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE establishes the content to be stored in the 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming list.
